deployment_assumptions: The component may be difficult to update post-deployment, emphasizing the need for robust design and thorough verification pre-deployment.
open_questions: What are the current process controls in place for dopant implantation?

prioritization_summary: Threats and requirements are prioritized based on the criticality of device integrity, potential leakage, unintended paths, and the impact of junction breakdown, as these can have significant repercussions for device operation and reliability.

prioritized_actions.next_step: Implement and refine isolation test procedures in the verification phase.
prioritized_actions.rationale: Prevention and detection of leakage are paramount to device function and cannot be resolved post-deployment.
prioritized_actions.title: Isolation Verification

prioritized_actions.next_step: Conduct a review of manufacturing thermal budgets and implement stricter control measures.
prioritized_actions.rationale: Addressing this threat minimizes manufacturing variations that lead to serious operational issues.
prioritized_actions.title: Dopant Diffusion Leading to Junction Breakdown

prioritized_actions.next_step: Enhance process parameter monitoring and audit procedures during doping stages.
prioritized_actions.rationale: Early and precise doping controls prevent a variety of downstream issues and ensure device stability.
prioritized_actions.title: Precision Doping Control

security_requirements.description: Ensure precise control of the doping process to prevent unwanted variations that could affect well characteristics.
security_requirements.design_robustness: Built-in process controls ensure compliance with design specifications despite external threats.
security_requirements.priority_rationale: Addressing doping control at the requirements phase prevents issues early in the manufacturing process.
security_requirements.requirement: Shall implement precise control and monitoring of doping implant parameters to ensure they meet exact specifications consistently.
security_requirements.title: Precision Doping Control
security_requirements.verification_method: Process audits and real-time parameter monitoring during doping stages.

security_requirements.description: Design and verify robust well isolation to prevent leakage paths between regions.
security_requirements.design_robustness: Ensures pre-deployment checking of isolation, making leakage unlikely even in unpatched devices.
security_requirements.priority_rationale: Prevents critical leakage issues that cannot be ameliorated once silicon is deployed.
security_requirements.requirement: Shall perform isolation verification tests post-fabrication to ensure no unintended leakage paths exist.
security_requirements.title: Isolation Verification
security_requirements.verification_method: Post-fabrication electrical testing and simulation of isolation effectiveness.

summary: Assessment focused on the integrity and control of doped regions, such as wells, critical for transistor operations and stability.

threats.deployment_consequence: Difficult to correct once devices are manufactured; requires redesign or process control improvements.
threats.description: Dopant atoms may diffuse unpredictably, potentially leading to junction breakdown and circuit failure.
threats.potential_impact: Junction breakdown can lead to circuit failure, data corruption, or device malfunction.
preconditions: Capabilities to alter thermal process settings.
threats.priority_rationale: High impact on reliability and difficult to mitigate post-fabrication if diffusion is uncontrolled.
threats.scenario: An attacker could tamper with the thermal budget during dopant diffusion, causing diffusion beyond intended boundaries.
threats.sdlc_phase_description: The threat emerges during manufacturing due to potential process variations and lack of control in diffusion rates.
threats.title: Dopant Diffusion Leading to Junction Breakdown

threats.deployment_consequence: Requires redesign or process modification; challenging to address without impacting existing silicon.
threats.description: Improper well isolation can create unintended leakage paths, affecting the integrity and performance of the circuit.
threats.potential_impact: Compromise of circuit functionality and efficiency, leading to higher power consumption and potential logic errors.
preconditions: Knowledge of well layouts and isolation methods.
Access to design tools or specifications.
threats.priority_rationale: Leaks affect core functionalities and are hard to patch post-production, requiring pre-deployment robustness.
threats.scenario: Malicious process interference leading to incomplete isolation causing leakage.
threats.sdlc_phase_description: Isolation strategies are determined during design, affecting the layout and interaction of wells and junctions.
threats.title: Unintended Leakage Paths

threats.deployment_consequence: Correction requires manufacturing adjustments, not feasible for deployed devices without redesign.
threats.description: Altering the implant dose during the doping process may change the characteristics of wells, impacting device behavior.
threats.potential_impact: Shift in transistor threshold voltages, leading to unreliable or incorrect circuit behavior.
preconditions: Inside knowledge of doping process steps.
Ability to alter or disrupt implant settings.
threats.priority_rationale: Moderate impact but rectifiable through stringent controls during manufacturing.
threats.scenario: An adversary modifies implant parameters to alter well characteristics deliberately.
threats.sdlc_phase_description: Occurs during the doping process; precise control is necessary to achieve desired electrical properties.
threats.title: Implant Dose Tampering
